assertion: Public school enrollment has plummeted by more than 1.4 million students since the pandemic, according to a recent study by Stanford University researchers Thomas Dee and Jaymes Pyne.
sql: SELECT year, SUM(CASE WHEN enrollment>0 THEN enrollment END) FROM edu.ccd_districts GROUP BY year
measure: public school enrollment by district NCES

assertion: One out of every 4 public schools in the U.S. has lost 15% or more of its student population since 2019, according to the study.
warehouse_value: 23,769 of 92,358 matched schools (25.7%) down 15%+, fall 2019 to fall 2024
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN b.enrollment<=0.85*a.enrollment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM edu.ccd_schools a JOIN edu.ccd_schools b ON a.ncessch=b.ncessch AND a.year=2019 AND b.year=2024

assertion: teacher headcounts have actually grown by 1% nationwide
warehouse_value: Matched districts: teacher FTE 2,854,039 to 2,889,803 (+1.25%) while enrollment fell 2.8%; paper says +0.9%
sql: self-join ccd_districts 2019 vs 2024 on leaid, positive values only

assertion: the overall number of schools in operation remains virtually unchanged
independent_value: Paper abstract: number of operating schools effectively unchanged

assertion: That's primarily due to declining birth rates and expanding school choice.
inaccuracy: The piece says primarily birth rates and school choice; Bellwether says birth rates are primary and school choice is minor but notable.

assertion: In Seattle, enrollment has fallen by roughly 8% since that year, to below 49,000 students.
inaccuracy: The claim says roughly 8%; CCD shows 55,986 to 50,773, a 9.3% fall by fall 2024 alone, and the below-49,000 level is a later year the warehouse lacks.
why_not: The 49,000 figure comes from the article itself; the warehouse tops out at fall 2024 (50,773), so the grade rests on direction and approximate size.
sql: SELECT year, enrollment FROM edu.ccd_districts WHERE leaid='5307710'

assertion: In San Francisco, where enrollment fell 10% since 2019
reason: Warehouse shows -7.4% (52,811 to 48,902) through fall 2024; ed-data.org, the cited source, failed to load, and no later enrollment data was found.

why_no_page: ed-data.org fetch failed with a PKIX certificate error

independent_value: ABC7 Oct 2024: 13 schools on closure/merger list; Feb 2026: $100M deficit

measure: public school enrollment by district NCES
